title: agent skills sources
description: One entry per repository, keyed by the name it goes by now.

name.description: A forge path, lower cased because forges ignore case.

skip.description: "mirror" excludes it, false overrides the heuristics.

version.description: A regex over tag names, or one per path glob. False follows commits, true trusts tags.

via.description: Sites that list it, absent for a manual entry.

deleted.description: The day GitHub stopped serving it.

was.description: Previous names, exposed as flake aliases.
